kubejs.ponder.singularity_extractor.head: Singularity Extractor
kubejs.ponder.singularity_extractor.text: First, build the main structure with the Schematicannon.
Place a temporary support block at the center.
Drop a Corrupti Dust and a Dark Matter to create a Black Hole.
Be careful - the Black Hole absorbs any nearby dropped items!
You can now remove the support block.
Place the Singularity Extractor on top of the structure.
Provide energy to activate the structure.
The Singularity Extractor is now fully operational.
